name: ReplyEmail
description: Replies to an existing email message using Microsoft Graph. Supports Reply and Reply All.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: mailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The mailbox containing the message to reply to.

fields.name: messageId
fields.label: Message ID
fields.description: The Microsoft Graph message identifier of the email being replied to.

fields.name: replyType
fields.label: Reply Type
fields.description: Choose whether to reply only to the sender or to all recipients.

selectOptions.label: Reply
selectOptions.description: Reply only to the original sender.

selectOptions.label: Reply All
selectOptions.description: Reply to the sender and all original recipients.

fields.name: comment
fields.label: Reply Message
fields.description: The text to include in the reply.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the status of the reply operation.
